body:
Part of **New page: Strategy** (72986e081ef982d9). Every page piece is Gleam compiled to JavaScript; server pieces are Rust (`tasks.rs`, `board.rs`). Nothing compiles to BEAM.

Decision: the vision is one internal Markdown document. No store.

- **Server (Rust, `tasks.rs`).**
  - Store `<root>/.solace/strategy/vision.md`. It is internal, so agents can't touch it (Spec 14 §1 rule 3), and the task server is its only writer.
  - `GET /vision` returns `{text, revision}`.
  - `PUT /vision` takes `{text, base}`. A `base` that doesn't match the current revision is refused (E7xxx), so two editors don't overwrite each other.
  - Send a root `{vision}` event, also in the replay. Route it beside `milestones|features` in `board.rs` ~3407, at the root only.
- **Briefs.** Investigate, work and discuss briefs say there is a vision and include it (or its first part), in `continuation_brief` (`board.rs` ~2235). This covers "Solace reminds agents to use the vision".
- **Page.** A Markdown view and editor. Reuse `editor`/`md` from `components`.
- **Spec and decision.** Spec 15 §1 says the vision belongs to the Strategy work, so a decision adds the section.

**Scope:** `solace-cli/strategy` is not in the root `solace.toml` yet. A human adds it, then it is added to this task's scope.
title: Strategy: Vision
